text: This is the operator portal. A quick tour of every page on the top nav.

First — what you're about to see is the operator portal, used for one-off uploads and spot checks. The production pipeline runs fully automated, end to end. No clicks, no logins, no humans in the loop.
Sign in with the password your administrator gave you.

Converter is the home page. Drag any patient PDF onto the dropzone, or click Browse Files. The badges show the six document types it handles — consent forms, specialist and GP referrals, pathology and radiology results.
Per-file options sit on each row. Override the document type if the classifier got it wrong, set the carrier code, and choose auto-file or queue for review.

Hit Convert. Bedrock vision reads the document, classifies it, and pulls out patient and routing details. Then download the HL7 from the queue, or drop it straight into the practice software's inbound folder.
The Log tab is the audit trail. One row per conversion — time, patient initials, document type, source, outcome, and any warnings. Filter by date range, and export to CSV.
Stats shows the same audit data as charts. Document type, outcome, and source — web uploads versus the email pipeline. Useful for monthly reporting.

Reference Data is where doctors and carriers live. Add a doctor with their provider number — that's how the HL7 message routes to the right inbox. Carrier codes go in the same place. Changes save automatically.
Data Handling explains how patient information is processed. In-memory only, no persistent storage, all infrastructure inside Australia on IRAP PROTECTED AWS services.
Privacy is the full Privacy Policy, written against the Australian Privacy Act and the thirteen Privacy Principles.
Sign out is in the top right. And remember — this portal is the manual path. In production, the same engine runs unattended on every inbound document.
